notes: New: Listen can vary where each repeated play starts and ends (up to 4 ayat), fade out inside the extra ayah, and pause between plays.
New: Settings > Updates > Auto update on Wi-Fi (off by default); the Settings page is now grouped in sections.
New: in Blind mode, pull down on an empty page to see the end of the page before, just enough to know where you are.
New: the replay voice command before your first word plays the ayah before, or says the surah's name.
New: in the car, Recite plays the ayah before (or says the surah's name) when it starts.
New: the Progress table names the surah of each page.
Fix: starting to recite in the middle of a page is followed, also after a link of the Progress page.
Fix: Play word and Play ayah replay the right part after a word marked "lost".
Change: a double tap on an old mistake adds a new one; it removes only a mistake of this session or one you just added.
